title: 🎦 Michigan Democratic Senate candidate:
text:
🎦 Michigan Democratic Senate candidate:"

" War with Iran was a foolish idea and the product of a 40-year plot"

"Abdulrahman Mohamed El-Sayed, Democratic Party candidate for the Michigan State Senate:"

"“War with Iran was a completely foolish idea—anyone could have foreseen its strategic error."

"🔹 There was only one person in the entire world who worked for four decades on a project to drag us into this war, and he is the prime minister of another government."

"🔹 He finally managed to find an ignorant and willing person to carry out his sinister plan.”
